title: Skeleton Warriors
overview:
As Prince Lightstar, you alone are the final defense against the terrifying skeletal brigade. This is no easy task, for Baron Dark holds half of the mighty Lightstar Crystal. With it, he can change anyone with an evil heart into an evil Skeleton slave. You must stalk him... you must conquer him... you must not return without the Crystal. If you fall... you and your once peaceful world will pay.

- Fully rendered 3-D characters and full motion video sequences
- 100 vicious enemies await you in 21 savage levels.
